size_semantics: linear width/height of original R, rounded; not segmentation coverage percentages
position_semantics: one current-size P only, left/right 4px bbox gap, bbox top/bottom aligned; all O/G/T matched per P
rendering_contract: original marked scene/sidebar; no inactive P graying; no maximum-size backing; same-size R/P exchange
cross_position_background: moving the sole P exposes/covers original background; outside-R/P equality applies within matched T/N only
target_selection: unchanged 104 feasible targets and two original donor assignments; no model outputs consulted
human_scope: 72 existing v2 selected stimuli cross-checked against actual reference PNG and RGB/RGBA pixels; no responses read
target_prompt: Identify the original object inside the red marked region in the left image. The rectangular image patch, whether inside the red region or near it, is an artificial distractor and is not the object to identify. Give a short answer; if the original object cannot be determined, answer UNKNOWN.
donor_check_prompt: What object is depicted in the image patch? Give a short answer; if it cannot be determined, answer UNKNOWN.
source_decode_policy: SHA-bound lossless RGB decoded directly from original JPEGs on human-stimulus platform
limitations: size changes target coverage and donor dimensions together
other-object overlap in newly placed P not evaluated
